| # Object 0x1400 to 0x1407 receive PDO communication parameters {#object-0x1400-to-0x1407-receive-pdo-communication-parameters-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object contains the communication parameters of the current PDO the device is able to receive.

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Index                             | 0x1400 to 1407                    |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | RPDO x Communication parameter    |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Object Code                       | RECORD                            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Data Type                         | PDO CommPar                       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Category                          | Conditional;                      |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | mandatory for each supported PDO  |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- ----------------------------
  Description     largest subIndex supported
  Access          RO
  Default Value   2
  Range           NA

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| SubIndex                          | 1                                 |
+===================================+===================================+
| Description                       | COB-ID used by PDO                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Access                            | RW                                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Default Value                     | Index 1400h: 80000200h + NodeID   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1401h: 80000300h + NodeID   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1402h: 80000400h + NodeID   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1403h: 80000500h + NodeID   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1404h: 80000201h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1405h: 80000301h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1406h: 80000401h            |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | Index 1407h: 80000501h            |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| Range                             | UNSIGNED32                        |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

  SubIndex        2
  --------------- -------------------
  Description     Transmission type
  Access          RW
  Default Value   UNSIGNED8
  Default Value   0xFE
